header: Short public posts, stored as text
lead: Three to eighteen cards, each with the post, the handle and where it was posted. Cards keep their own height, because an even wall of posts looks edited.
note: Nothing is embedded, so no third-party script runs and no consent banner appears.

posts.quote_text: The post goes in the quote field and is shown without quotation marks.
